Item 3. Key Information and Company Overview

Acme serves industrial customers through distributors in several countries, and its operating results depend on customer demand, component availability, and the timing of large orders.

During 2024, the company expanded its service organization and continued investing in product reliability, supplier qualification, cybersecurity controls, and employee training.

Management monitors liquidity, foreign exchange exposure, contractual commitments, and market conditions when allocating capital to operations and long-term projects.
